This is a fresh visual direction. Think contemporary independent culture magazine meets an approachable, credible community foundation. Conservative, exceptionally tasteful nonprofit foundation website. Ivory white, midnight navy, a small terracotta accent. Large beautiful classic serif headline with clean modern sans-serif body, generous whitespace, rigorous margins and fine horizontal rules. Credibility through photography, not badges or ornament. Design a restrained centered editorial hero with headline above a very wide original group photograph. Communities should be an ordered editorial directory with the original singers photo leading one side and clean small text entries on the other. Lower sections use elegant two-column text layouts, one understated navy title on an offwhite panel and plain underline links. Think a beautifully produced contemporary foundation annual report or university arts institution.
